document.about: True T-49-HC refrigerator spec sheet. Its DOORS list sets each feature as a bulleted item; one item breaks its line by hand after its first sentence, the next sentence going on at the item's hanging indent, and the list going on after it.

notes: #275: the line after the hand break, set at the item's hanging indent, read as a paragraph of its own between two items of the list.

checks.issue: #275: `Each door fitted with 12" (305 mm) long recessed handle …` was a paragraph between two items, cut off its item `Lifetime guaranteed recessed door handles.`

element.text: Lifetime guaranteed recessed door handles. Each door fitted with 12" (305 mm) long recessed handle that is foamed-in-place with a sheet metal interlock to ensure permanent attachment.
